name: nervous-bus
description: Steering for coding agents: rulings that cost real incidents to learn, each packaged with the check that enforces it

plugins.name: human-attention
plugins.description: Build for human attention: few words on screen, the design carries the meaning. Skill, copy audit, and a hook that reports the copy an edit adds.

plugins.name: evidence-before-done
plugins.description: Done means finished and shown. Skill, a hook that reports stubs and suppressions an edit adds, and a hook that sends the agent back once if it changed a screen and never looked at it.

plugins.name: keep-moving
plugins.description: Do not stall and do not spin. Skill, and a hook that blocks the third identical build or test run when nothing changed.

plugins.name: model-tiering
plugins.description: Every dispatch names its model, chosen by what would catch a wrong answer. Skill, and a hook that blocks a dispatch with no model.

plugins.name: isolated-dispatch
plugins.description: Every agent that edits gets its own worktree; nobody's uncommitted work is hidden. Skill, a hook that blocks an editing dispatch with no isolation, and a hook that blocks a bare git stash or pop.

plugins.name: remediation-ladder
plugins.description: Fix the cause at the highest rung: eliminate, automate, then inform. Skill, and a hook that blocks a command that skips a check instead of passing it.

plugins.name: falsify-your-gate
plugins.description: A test, gate, or detector counts only after you have watched it fail. Skill, and a hook that reports a test an edit adds that cannot fail.
